status: local fixture release (not reviewed, not published)

reproducibility.note: the AST build is a second full compile with the identity settings plus AST output; tools/deploy-plan.mjs refuses any unit whose bytes differ

profiles.abiIdRule: keccak(name ‖ for each function sorted by selector: selector ‖ keccak(canonical output tuple)) (tools/abi-id.mjs)

constants.note: parsed from the sources in `from` at release time; the ids are keccak256 of the UTF-8 preimage. Value 0 of each enum is reserved and never returned.

gasModel.note: Planning only, keyed by fee schedule: never apply one schedule's constants on a chain running the other. gas(publication) = fixed + Σ actions; a new PUBLISH costs publishNew[type] + perWord × ceil(bodyBytes / 32) + perByte × bodyBytes. Excludes the 21,000 intrinsic cost and calldata, which the caller adds from the encoded transaction. eth_estimateGas on the exact call stays the authority before sending.

prague.status: mainnet and Sepolia today (Fusaka); the cap counts all gas

floor.formula: The kernel's quote (LedgerIngress._foldAndQuote) over a publication of n actions: fresh10 = workModel.freshPerPublication + Σ over PUBLISH/REUSE (freshPerRef·types[T].refs, plus freshPerPublishFresh + freshPerDigestSpec·types[T].specs when the record is new) + Σ over BIND/UNBIND/RELEASE whose author's head at the position is UNSET (freshPerBindFresh); rw10 = rwPerPublication + rwPerPublish per PUBLISH/REUSE + rwPerBind per BIND/UNBIND/RELEASE; freshSlots = ceil(fresh10 / 10), rewrites = ceil(rw10 / 10); prefixFloor P = computeBase + n·computePerAction + binds·computePerHookEffect + freshSlots·limits.floorFreshGas + rewrites·limits.floorRewriteGas (binds = the BIND/UNBIND/RELEASE count); finalReserve F = finalComputeBase + binds·finalComputePerBind. The checks (design §6.4, §6.5): before callback i the kernel requires its gasleft g > F + T and forwards (g − F − T)·63/64 to the ingress, which spends at most dispatchOverhead, then requires (its gasleft)·63/64 ≥ R_i = max(0, P − the callbacks' spend so far) (E_INDEX_GAS otherwise); before the final phase it requires (g − T)·63/64 ≥ F. T = limits.kernelTail. Sufficient visible execution gas (G = the gas limit less intrinsic gas and calldata): G ≥ V = max(K + ceil((ceil(P·64/63) + dispatchOverhead)·64/63), E) + ceil(F·64/63) + T, where E is the publication's execution gas and K the kernel's own share of it (callbacks excluded): at callback i the gas spent so far is at most K plus the callbacks' spend s, and R_i·(64/63)² ≥ P·(64/63)² − s, so the kernel's spend and the floor never need more than K + P·(64/63)²; the final check needs at most E + F·64/63 + T. A planner uses the model's execution estimate for E (prague: constants; amsterdam: split.executionGas) and floor.kernel (the same model fitted with the callbacks removed) for K.
floor.quantity: execution gas visible to the GAS opcode (on amsterdam the EIP-8037 state-gas reservoir is not visible and the cap counts execution gas only)

amsterdam.status: EIP-8037/8038 (Glamsterdam); the cap counts execution gas only, and the total must also fit the block

planning.rule: A publication is planned when it is inside limits (1 ≤ actions ≤ maxActions, bind-kind actions ≤ maxBindsPerPublication, PUBLISH body bytes ≤ maxBodyBytesPerPublication) and max(E, V) ≤ floor(txGasCap × (100 − headroomPercent) / 100), on the schedule of the chain: E the model's execution estimate (prague: constants; amsterdam: split.executionGas), V the floor's visible-gas requirement (profiles.<schedule>.floor.formula). A shape that does not fit is split into publications before it is signed, never shortened; eth_estimateGas on the exact call stays the authority before sending, and the gas limit comes from the estimate, never from V.
planning.txGasCapRule: EIP-7825 (on amsterdam, EIP-8037: the cap counts execution gas only)
planning.headroomCovers: the 21,000 intrinsic cost, calldata (EIP-2028/7623) and the model's own error (under 9% on both schedules, maxAbsErrorPercent)

tagLists.note: A per-author (scope-below) or shared (place-below) roll-up list holding exactly one entry, or a multiple of five entries (zero included: an empty list), takes a fresh word on its next append, so price that append as new (tagLevel.mineNew or sharedNew); otherwise as existing. The fresh word costs one slot rewrite more than a new list, inside the headroom; not separately measured.

envelope.what: how many of one shape fit one atomic publication: the smallest of the gas budget and the Realm limits maxActions and maxBodyBytesPerPublication. For user-facing messages; plan with the constants.
envelope.budgetRule: floor(txGasCap × (100 − headroomPercent) / 100) − fixed, on the gas the cap counts

editSmall.what: edit a file: PUBLISH files-child/1 form 0 with 100 bytes of content, rebind HEAD

edit1k.what: the same with 1,024 bytes of content

createSmall.what: create a file: CREATE, PUBLISH files-root/1 form 0 with 100 bytes, PUBLISH a 12-byte name, BIND HEAD, BIND FOLDER

create1k.what: the same with 1,024 bytes of content

chunk.what: PUBLISH one 8,192-byte files-bytes/1 chunk (8,160 file bytes)

privilegedRoles.note: the fixture key owns the controller; administrator power is total before freeze (SECURITY.md)
